source: Explicit user instruction in the active conversation; no inferred approval.
user_instruction_excerpt: 本次允许在学校服务的容量、参数支持和默认 reasoning 尚未完全核实的情况下执行。这只解除“必须先取得完整服务文档”的阻塞，不解除输入冻结、调用预算、禁止自动重试等限制。遇到参数拒绝、上下文超限、超时／未知完成，或其他技术失败，暂停后续未发送请求，保存记录并报告。
unchanged_constraints: Exact frozen paired primary messages, original intents, TEMPORAL contract, four nodes, mixed quotas and whole-batch handling.
Each primary can receive at most one original-rule repair after a normally received, clearly completed response; technical failures never become content repair.
Each HTTP request counts immediately, including timeout and unknown completion; quota is never restored.
No automatic retry, HTTP redirect, 429 retry, SSL fallback, parameter removal, prompt/model change, or compensating samples.
Requested settings are not verified service adoption; actual model, finish_reason and full usage are retained; missing data and prices remain UNKNOWN.
No new Memory, extraction/reasoning split, Miner, Planner, Realizer, Solver, training, Free or extra audit model calls.
All calls are formal experiment calls, including failure, replaced primary and repair costs; no default-model upgrade; stop after reporting.
